title: August and the Verdict
author: Felix Fairweather
blurb: Ansel Brightwater, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
